name: townpulse-frontend
//engines: sharp (used by generate:og) requires Node >= 20.9.0 and needs a per-platform prebuilt binary. Declaring it here stops Vercel picking an older default and failing the build. node:20-alpine in the Dockerfile is >= 20.9, so it is fine as-is; if you pin it lower, sharp will not load.

scripts.//check:vercel: vercel.json is schema-validated by Vercel with additionalProperties:false, so an unrecognised key fails the deployment outright — and Vercel reports only the first violation. A "//" comment key there is invalid, unlike in package.json. This fails the build instead of production. Run with -- --refresh to reprint the allowed-key tables from the published schema.
scripts.//check:sw: Reads the EMITTED dist/sw.js, not the config. A service worker outlives a deployment: if it precaches index.html, or registers a NavigationRoute ahead of the runtime routes, it keeps serving the previous build's shell and a deployed fix stays invisible — no type check or unit test can see that. Run after `npm run build`.
scripts.generate:seo: npm run generate:og && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run generate:prerender
scripts.//build: Order matters. OG images and the sitemap are written into public/, which vite copies into dist/ — so they must exist BEFORE `vite build` runs, or they silently ship missing and every share preview 404s. Only prerender runs afterwards, because it reads the built dist/index.html.
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:og && npm run generate:sitemap
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run generate:prerender
